title: Communion released early because of 'some kind of resistance'

tellings.quote: I was told a publication date and then all of a sudden the books were in bookstores

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber says that in 1987 his book Communion showed up in American bookstores earlier than he expected. Speaking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, he says he had been given one publication date, and then all of a sudden the books were on the shelves, which he puts down to "some kind of resistance." If that were so, it would mean someone was working behind the scenes around how his story reached the public.
